name: google-business-profile-api
description: Google Business Profile accounts, locations, reviews, posts and performance metrics via the official Business Profile APIs

nodes.title: List Business Profile accounts
nodes.description: List the Business Profile accounts (personal, location groups, organizations) the credentials can access.

parent_account.description: Organization or user group account id, to list the accounts under it

account_type.description: Only accounts of this type (sent as the `type=` filter)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List Business Profile locations
nodes.description: List an account's locations (businesses) with title, address, phone, website and Maps ids. Location `name` is locations/{id}.

account_id.description: Account id from list_accounts, e.g. "123", "accounts/123" or a full resource name

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get Business Profile location
nodes.description: Get one location's details: profile description, phones, categories, address, regular and special hours.

location_id.description: Location id from list_locations, e.g. "456", "locations/456" or "accounts/1/locations/456"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Update Business Profile location
nodes.description: Update only the given fields of a location: description, primary/additional phones, regular hours (replaces all periods) and special hours (replaces all). Times are HH:MM, dates YYYY-MM-DD. Safe to resend after a failure.

location_id.description: Location id from list_locations, e.g. "456", "locations/456" or "accounts/1/locations/456"

additional_phones.description: Up to 2 extra phones; [] removes them

regular_hours.description: Opening periods, e.g. [{"open_day": "MONDAY", "open_time": "09:00", "close_time": "17:00"}]; close_day defaults to open_day, or the next day when close_time is before open_time (overnight)

validate_only.description: Only validate, do not change the location

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List Google Business Profile posts

nodes.title: Create Google Business Profile post
nodes.description: Publish a post on a location's Business Profile: STANDARD (update), EVENT or OFFER, with an optional button and photo URL. Never retried after an unknown outcome: check list_local_posts first.

account_id.description: Account id from list_accounts, e.g. "123", "accounts/123" or a full resource name

location_id.description: Location id from list_locations, e.g. "456", "locations/456" or "accounts/1/locations/456"

summary.description: Post text (max 1500 characters); required for STANDARD

language_code.description: Language of the post, e.g. id or en

call_to_action_type.description: Button; CALL uses the location's phone

media_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a photo (or video) Google fetches

event_start.description: EVENT/OFFER: start, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (location's time)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Delete Google Business Profile post
nodes.description: Delete a post from a location's Business Profile.

account_id.description: Account id from list_accounts, e.g. "123", "accounts/123" or a full resource name

location_id.description: Location id from list_locations, e.g. "456", "locations/456" or "accounts/1/locations/456"

local_post_id.description: Post id: the last part of the post's name

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.description: Daily performance of a location between two dates: impressions (Maps/Search, desktop/mobile), calls, website clicks, directions, messages, bookings.

location_id.description: Location id from list_locations, e.g. "456", "locations/456" or "accounts/1/locations/456"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Google Business Profile API request
nodes.description: Call any Google Business Profile API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/accounts/{account_id}/locations/{location_id}/media". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/accounts/{account_id}/locations/{location_id}/media"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
